title: FunctionGemma 270M Release
summary: Google released FunctionGemma in 270M parameter size on December 18, 2025. Google's official documentation describes FunctionGemma as a specialized Gemma 3 270M model trained for function calling and intended as a foundation for custom, fast, private, local agents.
significance: A dated Gemma-family release milestone focused on function calling and specialized local agent development.
